How many companies are listed on the Lusaka Securities Exchange?

What are the LuSE trading hours?

The Lusaka Securities Exchange trades 09:00–13:00 Lusaka time, Monday to Friday, excluding Zambia public holidays. Prices on Mansa Markets refresh every 30 minutes during the session.

How do I buy shares on the Lusaka Securities Exchange?

Open a trading account with a licensed Zambia stockbroker, fund it in ZMW, and place an order for the listed company you want. Settlement runs through the exchange's central securities depository. Compare licensed stockbrokers in Zambia.
